before.title: How much does virtual event production cost? | West Peek Productions
before.description: Many smaller moderated webinar productions can fall around approximately $2,500–7,500, while larger executive summits, conferences, and hybrid productions may range from approximately $10,000–50,000+ depending on complexity; these ranges are directional, not fixed quotes.
